question: What bills are coming before payday?
title: Bills before payday

cells.title: The bills on the way
cells.code:
PENSION = (me.get("age") or 0) >= 68
PAY = "pension day" if PENSION else "payday"
PAY_TO = "pension day" if PENSION else "payday"
CYCLE = "pension cycle" if PENSION else "pay cycle"
def day(s):
    d = datetime.date.fromisoformat(str(s)[:10])
    return f"{d.day} {d:%b}"
emit("pay_word", PAY, "text", "The day money comes in")
emit("pay_to", PAY_TO, "text", "The day money comes in")

b = kori.bills()
s = kori.safe_to_spend()
items = [{"label": i["label"], "date": i["date"], "amount": i["amount"]} for i in b.get("items") or []]
if items and abs(sum(i["amount"] for i in items) - b["total"]) < 0.005:      # the rows add up to the total on screen
    emit("bills_total", b["total"], "eur", b["label"])
    emit("bills_count", b["count"], "count", "Bills before payday")
    emit("next_payday", s["next_payday"], "date", "Next payday")
    table("bills", items, b["label"])
    say(f"**{eur(b['total'], True)}** in bills is due before {PAY} on {day(s['next_payday'])}, in {b['count']} {'payment' if b['count'] == 1 else 'payments'}.")
